arc: conversation (one continuous take): hook question ×3 → reply → link-preview reveal → feature question → answer → fire reaction → payoff line

scenes.title: WhatsApp dark thread with doodle wallpaper and read ticks
scenes.summary: A dark WhatsApp chat over the tiled doodle wallpaper, header 'Maya' whose subtitle swaps 'online' ↔ teal 'typing…' in sync with the typing bubble. Internal beats: problem — three tailed incoming bubbles with timestamps ('Ok so we're launching on Tuesday 🚀', 'and I still don't have a launch video 😭', 'what's the best tool for making one??'); turn — you type 'say less' in the floating pill composer (mic becomes a send arrow); reveal — 'genmotion.dev' sends as a green bubble with an inset link preview ('AI Product Launch Video Generator'); feature — 'wait it writes the scenes itself??' / 'and exports a real MP4', with grey ticks doubling then turning blue; payoff — 🔥 reaction on the link and 'ok I'm never opening After Effects again'.
scenes.build: Same bottom-up SCRIPT/TYPING/COMPOSE engine as the Instagram and Messenger templates (slot eases open, bubble springs in with a 26px rise), plus WhatsApp details in components/whatsapp.tsx: Wallpaper is an inline tiling SVG data-URI, Tail draws the squared-corner tail only on the first bubble of a run, Meta + metaReserve put the timestamp on the last line's baseline with an inline spacer so bubble heights stay predictable, and Ticks cross-fades grey→blue double-ticks at sentAt+10/+22.
scenes.reuse: Borrow for a WhatsApp-styled chat ad, or lift just the delivery-ticks, baseline-timestamp or doodle-wallpaper tricks into another chat UI. Swap SCRIPT copy, times, avatar and link card, and keep project.json SFX cues in step with each `at`. Don't copy the GenMotion link card or Maya persona for unrelated products.
